# Bank ad material sources

Drive primitive review, 27 October 2026:
- Interactive Holographic Material: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ghOjx8c1ikYqWIgF4BK6XzJ62eRQK45g/view . Local previously materialized package reviewed against its manifest. Source: https://github.com/ektogamat/threejs-vanilla-holographic-material at 25d7ce01782ea51a28bbc693aabd5ca36b24683c, MIT. HolographicMaterial.js and the full license are included here. Used for the home blueprint volume and the personal-card halo; blinking disabled, host-controlled time, subdued scan lines.
- Parametric Architecture Kit: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1X1I_nX5VJi5dAz6sjxDceo5Q1V2CEYK9/view . Reviewed its facade/window/roof composition pattern. The house in bank-world.js is custom geometry, not a copied kit implementation.
- On-screen Scroll Timing: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lobVzEvW3pJK00hcm_f2VjmD-U4ScVMX/view . Reviewed visibility/re-entry guidance. Visibility timing remains our own observer and local accumulator.
- Timeline Motion: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1GYRdKg6tnx48JgXtUMW1yDFbrx0Je2kX/view . Reviewed bounded timeline/reduced-motion patterns. The reversible blind projection and latches are custom host code.
- Also inspected local package notes for Curl Noise Flow Trails and LUMEN looped shaders while choosing a direction. Their GPU simulation/studio code is not included. The canvas contour ribbons are custom, lightweight analytic waves rather than a claimed reuse of those implementations.

The Halden branding, house, key, cash-flow installation, receipt, payment card, coin assembly, prism projection, copy and offer panels are authored for this fictional advertisement. No rate, real bank identity, account balance, return or regulatory protection is claimed. No external image or font request is added.
